  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  AUGUST 27, 2019

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 4:34 p.m., on
  Tuesday, August 27, 2019, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Gleam Davis
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich (arrived at 4:40 p.m.)
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Greg Morena
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:34 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Himmelrich. Councilmember
  Morena led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  CLOSED SESSION  Member of the public Denise Barton commented on closed session.

  Councilmember Himmelrich  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:38 p.m., to consider
  arrived at 4:40 p.m.  closed session and returned at 5:33 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  1.A. Public Employee Evaluation:
  Title: City Manager

  The Mayor reported that this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:33 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Gleam Davis
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  August 27, 2019
